# Daily Report — 2026-09-27

## Task Completed
Improved `bulk_tools.py` test coverage from 99% to 100%.

Added `tests/test_bulk_tools_coverage.py` with 24 new tests covering:

1. **"No valid updates to execute" defensive guard** — all 6 bulk functions
   (bulk_update_incidents, bulk_update_change_requests, bulk_update_problems,
   bulk_update_problem_tasks, bulk_update_change_tasks, bulk_update_request_items)

   `_resolve_problem_numbers`, `_resolve_problem_task_numbers`,
   `_resolve_change_task_numbers`, `_resolve_request_item_numbers`) now have
   explicit unit tests for: success with mapping result, empty result returning `{}`,
   and HTTP error propagation via `raise_for_status`.
